picks.why: Cleanest hat: plain matte felt, plain band and star, and no rim piping or extra studs. Natural crown-to-brim proportions.
Tonal overlay and two pull straps give a true boot shape. It avoids the dark inlay of 1 and the thin stitching of 3, and the chunky forms match the real card.
Reads at once as a lasso. Smooth rope twist and a compact floating coil, whereas 3 has fuzzier texture and 2 lies flat and spreads across the frame.
Doors and posts have believable proportions, with simple caps and clean louvres. It lacks the ball finials of 2 and the oversized curved doors of 1.
Only candidate. Solid cup form, though the red dot is an invented extra to remove in a redraw.
Centred, balanced saguaro with simple ribs and spines, seated naturally in the sand. 2 sits off-centre and 1 has a narrower, more awkward crop.

Best saddle construction: the wide fender leads down to the stirrup, and the horn and cantle are believable. It reads as a western saddle, where 1 has an overlong horn and 3 a thin English-style strap.
Only candidate. Good staves and iron hoops, though the orange stain and lid knob are extras to reconsider.
Simplest believable wagon: clean canvas, plain box, and a proper forked tongue. It has no rope ties like 2 and no stubby single tongue like 1.
Best locomotive proportions: headlamp centred on the boiler front, moderate stack, and restrained detail. 1 has an oversized flared funnel and 2 a side-set lamp with extra rails.
